title: Museum member accompanying person
naturalLanguageRequirements: A museum member is admitted to the galleries. The source text does not say whether someone who arrives with that member is admitted on the same visit.
informalMarkdown:
# Functions

## Admit a visitor

The desk admits a museum member to the galleries. Whether someone who arrives with that member is admitted on the same visit is not stated.

# Data Resources

## Member

The member records the membership number and the name.

# Constraints

## Member admission

A current member is admitted to the galleries.
